## HomeQuoteLink Delivery Probe - Confirm

**Purpose:** proves outbound HomeQuoteLink email is actually ARRIVING, not merely being accepted by the mail server.

**Why this exists:** on 2026-08-01 the Byethost account was under an outgoing-mail suspension. The SMTP server accepted every message, returned no error, and silently discarded it. No bounce is generated by a discard, so there is nothing to detect except by independently checking whether a sent message actually turned up.

**Flow:** the `email-canary` Supabase function sends a probe roughly hourly from admin@homequotelink.com to dgarcia89@gmail.com, with the subject `HomeQuoteLink Delivery Probe #<uuid>`. This workflow watches that Gmail inbox and posts the subject line back to `confirm-canary`, which extracts the token and stamps the probe confirmed.

**No auth on the confirm call, by design:** possession of the token IS the proof of delivery. Only a message that genuinely arrived can carry it.

**Order matters:** turn THIS ON FIRST, then enable "Check email delivery (canary)" in Admin -> Settings -> Background Jobs. The other way round, every probe correctly reports undelivered for the first hour and looks like a wall of alarms.

**If this workflow is OFF:** probes still catch hard failures (bad credentials, tripped circuit breaker). They will NOT catch silent discard - that specifically needs this running.

**Gmail credential must be dgarcia89@gmail.com** - it has to match `smtp_config.adminNotificationEmail`, which is where the probes are sent.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger — probe arrived
nodes.notes:
Watches ONLY for delivery-probe subjects. Deliberately narrow, for the reason recorded in _shared/emailSafety.ts: a sibling project's inbound workflow forwarded every message in its mailbox with no filter, and a self-addressed notification got re-ingested into a loop ~1,000+ times. newer_than:1d stops old probes being re-confirmed if this trigger is ever reset.

Polls every 5 minutes, not every minute (changed 2026-08-14). Probes arrive hourly and GRACE_MINUTES is 20, so a 5-minute poll still confirms with roughly a 4x margin before anything alarms — polling every minute meant ~59 of every 60 checks found nothing, for no gain in protection. Do not raise this above ~15 minutes without also raising GRACE_MINUTES, or a probe can be alarmed as undelivered before the poll that would have confirmed it ever runs.

nodes.name: Confirm delivery to HomeQuoteLink
nodes.notes: Posts the RAW subject rather than a token extracted here. confirm-canary accepts either, and letting its own extractTokenFromSubject() do the parsing keeps one canonical regex (_shared/canary.ts) instead of a second copy in n8n that could drift from it. The endpoint is verify_jwt=false and always returns 200 regardless of whether the token matched, so a non-probe message that slips through the filter is a harmless no-op.

meta.notes: Pattern adapted (read-only reference) from Mivos.ai's 'Mivos Email Delivery Probe — Confirm' workflow, which is a SEPARATE workflow on the same n8n instance and is not shared with this one. Uses the Gmail trigger rather than IMAP deliberately: the confirm leg must not depend on HomeQuoteLink's own mail infrastructure, since that is precisely what it exists to test. Contains no secrets — confirm-canary takes no auth by design (see the node note). Created 2026-08-14; see n8nWorkflowId below for the live copy, and update in place via PUT rather than importing a second copy.
